cards.title: we-including-you / we-excluding-you — clusivity: mark whether 'we' includes the reader

cards.title: or-both / not-both — English 'or' never says whether both is allowed

cards.problem: Is the reported set the whole population or only a proper subset?

cards.claim_guard: Do not call the supportive original confirmed until a disjoint carrier reproduces it.

proposal-by(

cards.title: repeat-event / restore-state — did ‘again’ repeat the action, or only bring the result back?
cards.problem: Did ‘again’ repeat the event, or only restore an earlier result state?
cards.after: repeat-event: Mara opened the gate. / restore-state(open(gate)): Mara opened the gate.
cards.consequence: The receiver can attribute a prior action only when the sentence actually commits to one.
cards.claim_guard: Do not present it as seconded, measured, or ratified; force embedding remains a stated research seam.
cards.allowed_claim: Candidate only: state that the row is proposed and explain the proposed distinction without implying adoption.
